notes.title: Free Update: The Circus
notes.content:
[p]Hello hoomans! ːcathspawː
Today is [b]International Cat Day[/b], a global celebration of all catkind! ːfofino2ː
It is a time to recognize the joy, companionship, and mystery that cats bring into our lives, while also raising awareness about the countless cats around the world still waiting for love, safety, and a forever home.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44744365/9f23f9095e2f0c54c4093f9f740821d69b33eaab.png"][/img]
To celebrate this special day, we have some exciting news.

The new update for [b]A Park Full of Cats[/b] is now live! ːwrycatː
If you can, consider supporting a local shelter, adopting, or simply spreading the word about the importance of feline welfare. Every small action makes a difference. And don't forget to have fun with your feline companions, they need it too.

And so you know: [b]A Building Full of Cats 2[/b] is on sale right now! So of you haven’t played it yet now is the perfect time! 
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2810730/A_Building_Full_of_Cats_2/"][/dynamiclink]Thank you for all your support. We hope you enjoy our special update for [b]A Park Full of Cats[/b].

Love and purrs
The Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ[/p]

notes.title: Meet Simba
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone!

I'm Simba, a friend of the Devcats! Just like my buddies, I was also rescued by the hoomans at Devcats, adopted, and now I live a very happy life with my human family! I was diagnosed with FeLV back in 2019 and still have lots of love to give. ːlovecatː[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44744365/7c994f3e24ea5a7637b8fe172cdf08f25c091960.png"][/img]
I've appeared in some previous Devcats games (can you remember which ones?), but this time they asked me to host a circus show! Since I’m so playful, I happily accepted the invitation!

To meet me, just head to the Park tomorrow and check out the new free update! ːwinkycatː
I'll be waiting for you there, okay?

Lots of headbonks!
Simba[/p]

notes.title: August 8th
notes.content:
[p]Hello hoomans!  ːwinkycatː

[b]International Cat Day[/b] is almost here and not only we are celebrating for all catkind we would also like to announce that [b]August 8th[/b] marks the release [b]A Park Full of Cats[/b] update!   

Featuring a brand new level, created as our way of saying thank you for playing and being part of our community. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44744365/6f190c093ad927d650dbe3842ac8360d9fea786a.png"][/img][i]Simba will be waiting for you![/i]
[/p][p]As always, we’re so grateful for your support. Don’t forget to have fun with your favorite feline friend! ːfofino2ː [/p][p]Love and purrs,
The Devcats[/p]

notes.title: A new stage is coming
notes.content:
[p]Hello hoomans! 

Are you ready for more [b]A Park Full of Cats[/b]?

Last year, we released this game to celebrate the joy of having fun with your cats. This year, we’re adding a [b]NEW stage[/b] to [b]A Park Full of Cats[/b]! We hope you all enjoy it!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44744365/3d1f06e2c0f2ed422a60ecda59806ddefe4cf8ea.png"][/img][/p][p]
The update will be released for the main game for free! ːlovecatː

Also, don’t forget to check out our latest release:

[b]A Building Full of Cats 2[/b] — our very first direct sequel and the successor to the game that started it all!  

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2810730/A_Building_Full_of_Cats_2/"][/dynamiclink]Thank you for all your love and support. ːfofinoː

Love and purrs,
The Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ[/p]

notes.title: Thank you, hoomans!
notes.content:
Hello hoomans! 

We want to give a huge thank you to all of you for the amazing reception and the incredibly kind reviews we’ve been receiving for [b]A Park Full of Cats[/b]! The game has officially left the limited profile category, and we couldn’t have done it without your support! ːfofinoː

It truly makes all the difference in the world for us, and we’re so grateful! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vftCOnd.png[/img]

To celebrate, we’ve got something special to share: Today is Leo’s 2nd birthday, our most adventurous cat here at the studio! As a gift, he got his very own park to play in and explore! ːwrycatː

Once again, thank you for all the love – we’re overjoyed by your support! ːfofino2ː

Love and purrs,
The Devcats

notes.title: A Park Full of Cats is here!
notes.content:
Hello hoomans!

[b]A Park Full of Cats[/b] is finally here! This game is all about cats having fun, and we hope you and your fur babies have a fantastic time playing it. We’ve poured so much love and effort into this game—it’s our biggest scenario yet! Not only are there loads of hidden cats, but we’ve also included plenty of quests from the Devcats for you to embark on! ːwrycatː

We’ve also put extra care into the [b]Haunted Ride[/b] DLC, making it something truly special. It’s even longer than the base game, with 8 stages full of spooky surprises. The theme is perfect as Halloween approaches, and the [b]Haunted Ride[/b] DLC is available today! ːcatbatː

Both main-game and DLC have a beautiful soundtrack composed by [url=https://www.youtube.com/@sinewavy][b]nobonoko[/b][/url]. His music really brought [b]A Park Full of Cats[/b] to life and adds a special touch to the game! Please check his music out if you enjoyed it [url=https://www.youtube.com/@sinewavy][b]here[/b][/url]! 

We hope you enjoy [b]A Park Full of Cats[/b] as much as we loved creating it. If you do, make sure to check out our next release:[b] A Shelter Full of Cats[/b].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3087650/A_Shelter_Full_of_Cats/
[b]WISHLIST NOW!!![/b]

[b]A Shelter Full of Cats[/b] is a hidden object game set in a cat shelter specially designed for cats with special needs. In this game, you'll help Hannah as she prepares a charity party to help these cats find their forever homes.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vDvtzC3.gif[/img]

With [b]A Shelter Full of Cats[/b], we aim to shine a light on these often overlooked sweet souls, who sometimes don't get the attention and love they deserve because they are a little different. 

Let's make a change for a better world for everyone! ːfofino2ː

Join us in [b]A Shelter Full of Cats[/b], releasing in November.

Love and purrs,
The Devcats ฅ^•⩊•^ฅ

notes.title: 3 Days Left!!!
notes.content:
Hello hoomans!

Leo here with some exciting news! This Monday, [b]A Park Full of Cats[/b] and the [b]Haunted Ride DLC[/b] will officially be live! So mark your calendars and come enjoy the park with me and the whole crew! Cats need fun, and what better place than a catified amusement park?

[img]https://i.imgur.com/eAIZZBK.png[/img]

I hope this game inspires many of you to catify your homes—then we can have fun every day! And speaking of catified spaces, have you checked out [b]A Shelter Full of Cats[/b] yet? It’s a game where you'll discover a delightful shelter for cats with special needs! You can check it out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3087650/A_Shelter_Full_of_Cats][b]here[/b][/url]! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3087650/A_Shelter_Full_of_Cats

Remember to wishlist the game if you like what you see!

And don’t forget: [b]A Park Full of Cats[/b] and the [b]Haunted Ride DLC[/b] are launching on September 9th!

Love and purrs,
Leo

notes.title: Get ready for a ride!
notes.content:
Hello hoomans!

This is Lino! Bet you couldn’t tell if that was a meow or a roar! ːwrycatː
Think I’m just all fluff? Well, maybe... But today I’m here to talk about our new game, [b]A Park Full of Cats[/b], and its DLC, [b]Haunted Ride[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YLbohrn.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2673390/A_Park_Full_of_Cats_Haunted_Ride/

This DLC brings 8 new levels and some really interesting surprises! In it, you’ll need to help Catherine solve a monster problem in the park. ːcathspawː 
It’s all set on a haunted train ride—which, by the way, I’m definitely not scared of! I just have other important things to do, which is why I’m not riding it. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/h9lHHyi.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QNTCGVv.png[/img]

So, be brave, hoomans! And by the way, where did these monsters even come from?

[b]A Park Full of Cats[/b] and the [b]Haunted Ride[/b] DLC are launching on September 9th!

Love and purrs, 
Lino

notes.title: A Park Full Of Cats most fabulous news!
notes.content:
Hello hoomans!

Giovani here, the most fabulous cat in the park! This place is huge, and guess what? The entry is [b]totally free[/b]! I've been invited to model here, so I hope you’ll come find me and snap a photo together! ːwinkycatː

[b]A Park Full of Cats[/b] is the latest game in the Full of Cats series, where you can pet all the cats in a massive park! There will be around 400 cats to look for and 100 + itens from quests! 

I could use your help with a few things too. For instance, I seem to be missing some [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2610090/view/4375894859697873345][b]photos of my fans[/b][/url]—could yours be among them? ːwadacatː

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9OaPqgT.png[/img]

You can come enjoy my fabulousness and all the fun without spending a single treat. So, grab your front-row seat and join us at [b]A Park Full of Cats[/b]! And don’t forget to strike a pose for the camera! ːpapyruswackyː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2610090/A_Park_Full_of_Cats/

[b]A Park Full of Cats[/b] will be released September 9th! 

Love and purrs, Giovani

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
Hello hoomans, listen up! 

Judy here, your trusty security officer, with some important news! Our brand-new game, [b]A PARK FULL OF CATS[/b], is launching for [b]FREE[/b] on Steam on [b]September 9th! [/b] ːstareyescatː

I’m here to ensure you take the necessary safety step of adding the game to your wishlist so you don’t miss the big day!

In this game you’ll explore one big, bustling theme park with all the elements you expect from our Full of Cats series: cute cats to find and side-quests given by our usual suspects! Help the crew around the Park so that all cats can have the fun they deserve! ːcathspawː

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vUmAkLn.png[/img]

There will also be a special paid DLC available on the release date for those who want to further adventure in the world of [b]A PARK FULL OF CATS[/b], and we will bring more news about it soon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2673390/A_Park_Full_of_Cats_Haunted_Ride/

Remember, hoomans: Safety first, fun always! See you on September 9th! ːwinkycatː

Love and purrs,
Officer Judy, The Devcats

notes.title: Your cat in A Park Full of Cats!
notes.content:
Hello, hoomans!

We’re thrilled to announce a special promotion for our upcoming game [b]A PARK FULL OF CATS[/b]! ːlovecatː

We want to have your beloved kitty in [b]A PARK FULL OF CATS[/b]! All you need to do is share photos of your cat in their favorite catified spaces. We’re looking for creative, cozy, and fun spaces that show just how much you love and care for your feline friends. ːfofinoː

[b]How to Participate:[/b]
[list][*] Join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/rr8zmYk9VH][b]Discord server[/b][/url] if you haven’t already. 
[*] Head over to the dedicated channel 
[*] [b]Post a photo of your cat in a catified space.[/b] It can be anything from a cozy cat tree, an adorable cat house, a fun tunnel, to a creative DIY cat corner!
[*] The first 30 qualified photos will be featured in [b]A PARK FULL OF CATS[/b]![/list]

We can’t wait to see all the amazing catified spaces you’ve created! Let’s make [b]A PARK FULL OF CATS[/b] the most pawsome game yet with your help. ːfofino2ː

Love and purrs,
The Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ
